proposed_limits.placement_semantics: Reserve once before native ELF exec, verify existing reservation inside worker; probes are placeholders until separately approved and implemented.

byte_budget.note: Includes132 fullrows/request conservatively covering sampling/frontier and ownership copies; RESET rawtensorbytes are0. Archive uses2percent expansion plus16MiB headers; source/model weights are separately bound, not duplicated into rawcaptures.

archive_file_budget.producer_scope: Own producer for R/repeat/strong natural requests only; cold oracle replays R canonical IDs and has no independent producer. The32-record bound is conservative allowance, not an executed or planned32-producer count.
archive_file_budget.required_archive_guard: At most4096 outerentries, each header/PAX envelope at most4096bytes;16MiB totalheader budget. Do not silently include an unbounded extracted upstream tree.

wall_time.note: RPC/fsync cost and real model/capture work are unmeasured. Exceeding deadline must preserve partial data and stop, without starting a new worker.

gates: Fresh resource/UUID/quiet-window verification before any future admission.
Native schema producer receipts, capture/record size caps, entrycount/ledger caps and actual controller graph must remain enforced.
Ten deployment limits include two prospective probe placements and eight workers; no existing quota or old STATE is reused.
Accounting ACKs, static source maps and compiled linkage are not native execution permission.
